## **ORDER** 

The present Petition has been filed by the Petitioners, NTPC Vidyut Vyapar 

Nigam Limited (NVVNL) seeking the following reliefs: 

_“(i) To exercise the Power to Remove Difficulty under Regulation 42 of the CERC (Connectivity and General Network Access to the inter-State Transmission System) Regulations, 2022 and in the interim to continue the procedure prevailing under the CBTE Regulations, 2019 for processing the applications of participating entities / cross border entities seeking connectivity;_ 

_(ii) To amend Regulation 17.1 of the GNA Regulations, 2022 in terms of Para 19 of the present petition;_ 

_(iii) To issue an appropriate amendment recognizing cross-border entities to assume the liabilities with regard to the GNA including the signing of the transmission agreement with the CTU._ 

_(iv) To amend / introduce a provision linking the time period of deemed GNA for cross border entities with the time period of the PPA_ 

_(v) To pass such further Order/Orders as this Commission may be deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_
